business_overview.one_sentence: The company is a Bermuda-incorporated investment holding company whose subsidiaries operate hotel hospitality, money lending, liquor and wine trading, and listed securities investment.
business_overview.revenue_model: Hotel room and food and beverage income, liquor and wine sales, dividend income from listed securities, and potential money lending interest income; no money lending interest income was recognized in FY2025.
business_notes: Listed securities drove reported profit in FY2025 through HK$35.064 million fair value gain and HK$8.385 million dividend income.
Money lending gross principal and interest receivables were fully impaired.

non_recurring_items.item: Net fair value gain on FVTPL financial assets
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Unrealised market value gain on listed securities portfolio.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of comprehensive income and note 22, pp.115,185

non_recurring_items.item: Dividend income from FVTPL financial assets
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Dividend income from listed securities investments.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of comprehensive income and note 6, pp.115,154

non_recurring_items.item: Bank and financial institution interest income
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest income from bank balances and deposits in a financial institution.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, p.121

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss - Hong Kong listed securities
funds_assets.business_substance: Level 1 listed securities portfolio measured at market value.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 22, pp.117,185

funds_assets.business_substance: HKD deposits placed with a licensed financial institution; part of unutilised rights issue proceeds was allocated for repayment of bank borrowings.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 note 23 and MD&A use of proceeds, pp.25,186

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks, including HK$6.032 million short-term time deposits and HK$1.168 million RMB bank balances in the PRC.
Bank deposits pledged to secure borrowings.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 26, pp.117,189

operating_assets.business_substance: Primarily Japan hotel land and building; hotel hospitality CGU had relatively low occupancy and incurred losses.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 15, pp.117,175-177

operating_assets.item: Trade receivables, other receivables, deposits and prepayments
operating_assets.business_substance: Trade receivables, recoverable taxes, other receivables, deposits and prepayments.

investment_assets.business_substance: Gross loan principal and interest receivables of HK$242.263 million were fully impaired; carrying value is nil.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 note 21 and MD&A loan impairments, pp.19,183-184

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured bank loan due within one year, secured by Japan hotel land/building, pledged bank balances, and subsidiary equity.
Lease liabilities for land and buildings.

operating_liabilities.item: Trade payables, other payables and accruals
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables, other tax payable, other payables and accruals.
Advance consideration received from customers, expected to be recognized within 12 months.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, p.117

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred tax liability mainly from fair value adjustment arising from business combination.

years.source: Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, pp.121-123
Annual Report 2025 comparative cash flow statement, pp.121-123

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: FY2025 reported profit did not convert to operating cash. Operating cash flow was negative and profit was mainly listed securities fair value gains and dividends.

gaps: Annual report does not split all cash and deposits by holding entity, parent/subsidiary, offshore/onshore, or withdrawal restrictions other than RMB bank balances and pledged balances.
Only two annual years are directly available in the 2025 annual report text used here; three-year median cash conversion was not rebuilt from older annual reports in this run.
Maintenance capital expenditure is approximated by current-year purchases of property, plant and equipment because the report does not split maintenance and growth capex.
